claims.text: Elias’s modern route label and Ming tea-network statement are distinct from an original journey. Huo and Ren’s reconstruction additionally identifies a Tang–Song Qingxi/Lingguan connection between Chengdu and Dali, overlapping the early selected period, then a Yuan–Ming–Qing reorientation toward Kunming. The study uses historical nodes, modern roads and interpolation. These attributed historical relationships do not prove unchanged direct service throughout 1200–1700, an exact dated journey or sovereignty. Original travel sources remain uncollated.
